key: You'd think Focus Sashes would be in this section, but it seems they were pulled to a higher floor.
en: You'd think Focus Sashes would be in this section, but it seems they were pulled to a higher floor.
ja: きあいのタスキはこの区画にありそうなものだけど、上の階に移されたみたいだ。

key: I wonder if there are more TMs upstairs somewhere?
en: I wonder if there are more TMs upstairs somewhere?
ja: 上の階のどこかに、もっとわざマシンがあったりしないかな?

key: Man, I finally got all these Power Items...
en: Man, I finally got all these Power Items...
ja: いやあ、ようやくこのパワーアイテム全部そろえたよ……

key: But they sure were expensive, weren't they?
en: But they sure were expensive, weren't they?
ja: でも、結構高かったよな?

key: I wish I could just tell someone "powerpack" and then they'd give me a bunch of these Power Items for free!
en: I wish I could just tell someone "powerpack" and then they'd give me a bunch of these Power Items for free!
ja: 誰かに「powerpack」って言うだけで、このパワーアイテムをどっさりタダでくれたりしないかなあ!
それって最高だと思わない?!

key: Capitalism would collapse in on itself...
en: Capitalism would collapse in on itself...
ja: 資本主義が自壊しちゃうよ……

key: These boosted power EV items really pack a punch!
en: These boosted power EV items really pack a punch!
ja: この強化型努力値アイテム、なかなかの効き目だぜ!

key: I hear the augmented ones here are four times the strength as the ones they have in other regions!
en: I hear the augmented ones here are four times the strength as the ones they have in other regions!
ja: ここの強化版は、他の地方のものより四倍も強力らしいぜ!

key: They also prevent you from gainin' EVs other than their own type.
en: They also prevent you from gainin' EVs other than their own type.
ja: その代わり、対応タイプ以外の努力値は入らなくなる。

key: This is the fourth floor: Consumable Items and Special I.
en: This is the fourth floor: Consumable Items and Special I.
ja: ここは4階、消耗品と特別アイテムIのフロアだ。
